boundary: Documented field lookup with explicitly restricted selectors and lexical normalization. Tests establish offline prototype behavior only; compiler/controller equivalence and excluded forms remain unverified.

rules.documented: USING struct_var{,struct_var} DO statements ENDUSING permits unqualified structure fields. Fields override same-named variables; the right-most listed structure containing a field wins. The translator searches listed variables from right to left.
rules.implemented: One or more bare named STRUCTURE variables, including routine locals and reference formals. Direct fields override ordinary variable names; unmatched names retain lexical lookup. Unqualified fields become explicit field expressions before type, effect and flow analysis. Qualified-root identifiers undergo the same documented field precedence; inserted qualifiers are not rewritten again.
rules.restriction: Nested USING, indexed/field/function selectors, call/constant-name collisions and shadowed FOR counters remain blocked. Only direct fields are exposed; nested fields retain explicit dot paths. The inspected field-versus-variable rule does not independently establish constant/routine namespace priority; those collisions are explicit prototype exclusions.

rules.implemented: Resolved scalar/STRING/ARRAY/STRUCTURE fields use existing reference/value rules, narrow numeric promotion and physical capacities. Caller USING aliases do not change a separately declared callee's name lookup. Fresh routine locals, RETURN and error cleanup retain their existing behavior. Reports record selector priority and source-located resolved uses.
rules.restriction: STRING value inputs require read-only formals under string_value_semantics.json; STRUCTURE values use structure_routine_semantics.json; whole ARRAY values remain blocked. General controller ownership, namespace collisions and stack behavior are not authenticated.

rules.implemented: Existing IF/SELECT/WHILE/REPEAT and unshadowed FOR forms operate on qualified fields. Same-block jumps and exits to ancestors include USING blocks; jumps into nested/sibling USING blocks and FOR-body labels/jumps are rejected. Alias normalization precedes transitive write-effect analysis so global/formal field writes cannot bypass expression-order checks.
rules.restriction: These flow/effect and alias-lifetime policies remain prototype restrictions, not controller observations. Shadowed FOR counters, unsupported jump entries and order-sensitive calls remain fail-closed.
